summary: Reconocimiento de hablante local (cerrado, con consentimiento) para personalizar y enrutar contexto. Nunca autentica.
secrets: vault key (32 bytes) supplied by the host secret store
invariants: Results always carry authorizes:false and assurance:'convenience'; a voice match is never an authentication factor.
Templates exist only inside the AES-256-GCM vault; raw recordings and per-sample vectors are not stored.
Enrolment and identification require an active consent record; minors require a parent or legal guardian.
Closed-set only: it identifies consented household members and rejects everyone else as unknown.
Consent withdrawal deletes the template; forget() erases the subject.
reuseNotes: Provide a SpeakerEmbedder (HttpSpeakerEmbedder + sidecar/speaker_embed_server.py), a VaultStorage and a 32-byte key from your secret store. Calibrate SpeakerPolicy thresholds with the real model before relying on results. Wrap with a thin adapter per host product (Janus: packages/adapters/src/speaker-recognition-adapter.ts).
